name: Hogan Personality Inventory (HPI)
description: A 206-item personality measure designed specifically for the workplace, assessing seven primary scales: Adjustment, Ambition, Sociability, Interpersonal Sensitivity, Prudence, Inquisitive, and Learning Approach.
reputation: Strong predictive validity for job performance; widely used in high-stakes selection and leadership development.
notes: Proprietary; requires licensed provider; designed for adults in work contexts.
